difficultyRationale: Distinguishes three kinds of list: unmodifiable, fixed-size but writable, and ordinary. The candidate must know exactly which mutations each one allows.

explanation: List.of returns an unmodifiable list, so add throws UnsupportedOperationException. Arrays.asList returns a fixed-size list backed by the array: set is allowed, but add and remove are not. The set call changed the first element to q, and the failed add left the list unchanged.

options.explanation: Both add calls throw UnsupportedOperationException, and the only successful change is the set call on the fixed-size list.
add on the Arrays.asList list also throws UnsupportedOperationException because its size is fixed, so fixed-size is printed as well.
set is permitted on a fixed-size list, so the first element does become q.
The add call threw an exception, so z was never added.
